notifications.title: Restriction on plying of goods vehicles on notified roads of Delhi
notifications.authority: Transport Department, GNCT of Delhi
notifications.gazette: Delhi Gazette Extraordinary, Part IV, No. 215 (4 Aug 2021)
notifications.summary: Issued under Section 115 of the Motor Vehicles Act. Restricts goods vehicles (HGV, MGV, LGV) on listed roads during notified hours.

notifications.title: Amendment to the 2021 goods-vehicle restriction notification
notifications.authority: Transport Department, GNCT of Delhi
notifications.summary: Revises the road list and hours. Peak hours 07:00-11:00 and 17:00-23:00 on the listed roads; 12:30-20:00 in notified market areas; e-LGVs (L5N, N1) exempt. This app uses the schedule as amended.

notifications.title: Uniform day-time hours for goods-vehicle restrictions
notifications.authority: Delhi Traffic Police
notifications.summary: Day-time restriction hours fixed at 07:00-23:00. Peak hours 07:00-11:00 and 17:00-23:00 for HGV, MGV and LGV where such restrictions exist. Not a city-wide ban.

notifications.title: No Entry Permission for goods vehicles
notifications.authority: Delhi Traffic Police
notifications.summary: Goods vehicles needing to enter during restricted hours must hold a No Entry Permission from Delhi Traffic Police. The app does not issue or check permissions.

notifications.title: Gurugram: no standing city-wide no-entry timetable found
notifications.authority: Gurugram Traffic Police (Haryana)
notifications.summary: The map and place search now cover Gurugram. I could not find a published, standing no-entry gazette for Gurugram that lists roads and hours. Restrictions there are issued as road-specific or event orders (for example heavy vehicles between Pachgaon Chowk and IMT Manesar, 9 AM to 9 PM, during flyover work). None are applied to routing. Delhi rules still apply on Delhi roads. If you have a Gurugram notification, send it and it will be added. You can also report a no-entry road yourself.

notifications.title: Noida and Greater Noida: no standing city-wide no-entry timetable found
notifications.authority: Gautam Buddh Nagar Police Commissionerate (Uttar Pradesh)
notifications.summary: The map and place search now cover Noida and Greater Noida. I could not find a published, standing no-entry gazette that lists roads and hours. Heavy-vehicle bans there are issued as temporary event or festival orders (for example around trade fairs and Republic Day), typically 7 AM to 10 or 11 PM on affected routes. None are applied to routing. If you have a notification, send it and it will be added. You can also report a no-entry road yourself.

notifications.title: Ghaziabad: no standing city-wide no-entry timetable found
notifications.authority: Ghaziabad Traffic Police (Uttar Pradesh)
notifications.summary: The map and place search now cover Ghaziabad. I could not find a published, standing no-entry gazette that lists roads and hours. Ghaziabad restrictions are usually temporary orders, such as heavy commercial vehicles barred from NH-9 around festival rush, with traffic sent to the Delhi-Meerut Expressway and Eastern Peripheral Expressway. None are applied to routing. If you have a notification, send it and it will be added. You can also report a no-entry road yourself.
